getSpendableFunds.note: Internal B4 function (server/banking/funds.js), not an HTTP route. spendable = provider available (balance if null) − goal holds (sum of goals.saved_cents) − settlement holds (sum of settlements.hold_cents where the account pays). null when the account was never synced.

reserveFundsInsufficient.note: B4 acceptance: with $50 spendable, a $40 goal contribution and a $30 settlement cannot both reserve. The loser surfaces as HTTP 409.
